scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @tb/server" "npm run dev -w @tb/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tb/client && npm run build -w @tb/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/engine && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && npm run check -w @tb/client
